text:
maria: Heads-up — I can reliably hang the sample Go generator when cancelling a streaming request that hits a 429 retry path. small repro attached.

kevin: how to repro?

maria: steps:
1) run `./sampleapp gen --stream` against dev-runtime with 429 injection
2) after first token appears, hit Ctrl-C
3) process stays alive, goroutines leak.

jia: my guess: retry/backoff loop isn't selecting on ctx.Done(), so it waits the backoff timer while a reader goroutine still holds the response body. generator sees cancel but can't fully unwind.

sam: can you paste logs & a stack?

maria: logs:
```
2026-03-22T14:02:11.123Z INFO gen: started stream request
2026-03-22T14:02:11.456Z WARN http: 429 received, scheduling retry in 500ms
2026-03-22T14:02:12.000Z INFO gen: token chunk: "Hello"
2026-03-22T14:02:12.100Z INFO gen: user cancelled (ctx done)
2026-03-22T14:02:13.000Z INFO retry: backoff waiting (ctx ignored)
2026-03-22T14:02:15.000Z INFO gen: reader goroutine still active
```
stack snippet:
```
created by github.com/redwood/inference/sdk/runtime.(*streamer).start
  /path/to/sdk/streamer.go:142 +0x45
```

kevin: yep — cancel observed at top-level but retry middleware still blocks.

jia: minimal fix: make retry loop accept ctx, and have timers/select check ctx.Done() so it returns an error (maybe sdk.ErrCancelled) and ensures any response bodies/readers are closed. Also ensure the stream helper's ReadCloser respects context and returns EOF on cancel so scanners stop.

sam: two asks: 1) does this only happen for 429, or also 5xx? 2) add a test harness in sampleapp that asserts process exits quickly after cancel.

maria: 5xx hits same retry path, so likely both. I'll add harness that times out if process doesn't exit within 500ms after cancel.

kevin: prefer small API change. Pass ctx into retry middleware and propagate a wrapped cancel error. Avoid global signals.

jia: also audit other middleware that uses time.After() or time.Sleep() — they should select on ctx.Done().

maria: opening PR: stop backoff waiting on ctx, close bodies on early exit, add sampleapp test and docs blurb.

sam: assign to eng-runtime + devex for review. @oncall-bot set a 24h reminder to recheck flaky CI. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: reminder set — will ping #eng-runtime in 24h if CI still flakes.

kevin: if you want I can help polish the harness/tests.

maria: thanks, will request review.

sam: docs note: add a short entry to Go SDK troubleshooting about cancel semantics with streaming+retries to prevent patterns that keep processes alive.

maria: will include in PR description.

kevin: summary: generator streaming + retry backoff can block shutdown. PR will add ctx-aware backoff, close readers on cancel, sampleapp test, and docs blurb.
